testSource:
test('reordering twice in quick succession keeps the second order', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/')
  await expect(page.getByTestId('task-card')).toHaveCount(3)
  await dragTo(page, 'Beta', 2)
  await expect(page.getByTestId('task-list')).toHaveText('Alpha, Gamma, Beta')
  await dragTo(page, 'Gamma', 1)
  await expect(page.getByTestId('task-list')).toHaveText('Alpha, Gamma, Beta')
})
